entry.summary: Richard (Dick) Edmundson is a secondary school principal working in schools for them to be desirable places for all to learn and work. Reconnecting school and community, he is currently Principal of Ōhautahi Christchurch’s Te Aratai College (formerly Linwood College). Emphasising whanaungatanga, Learning-focussed relationships with students, whānau, staff and the wider community, from social agencies to businesses, define his practice as a school leader. His career includes Principal of Hornby High School and Assistant Principal at Aranui High School.
